source.wave: World Values Survey Wave 7 (2017-2022), country-pooled datafile v6.0
source.retrieval_note: Field titles, response labels, and index directions were checked against the official WVS Wave 7 online analysis pages.

responses.0: early childhood education (ISCED 0) or no education

responses.2: one needs to be very careful when dealing with people

Y003.label: autonomy index
Y003.direction: Lower values emphasize obedience and religious faith; higher values emphasize determination, perseverance, and independence.

I_AUTHORITY.label: inverse respect for authority
I_AUTHORITY.direction: Higher values indicate less respect for authority.

I_NATIONALISM.label: inverse national pride
I_NATIONALISM.direction: Higher values indicate lower national pride.

EQUALITY.label: equality orientation
EQUALITY.direction: Higher values indicate stronger equality orientation.

I_DEVOUT.label: inverse devoutness
I_DEVOUT.direction: Higher values indicate lower religious devoutness.

excluded_from_prompt.N_REGION_WVS: This is a country-specific regional identifier. It has no shared cross-country interpretation and is retained only for numerical reproducibility, not presented to the LLM.
